Create Table.description: Creates a Hive table to hold records loaded by later steps.

Insert Rows.description: Inserts a few rows built from the incoming payload.

Insert From Select.description: Builds a summary table from raw data inside Hive.
Insert From Select.code:
// Overwrite a summary table from a query on the raw table.
query(`
  INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE monthly_anc_summary
  SELECT district, substr(visit_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS anc_visits
  FROM anc_visits
  GROUP BY district, substr(visit_date, 1, 7)
`);

Count Records.description: Counts rows in a table, e.g. as a data-quality check.
Count Records.code:
// Count all rows in a table. Results are on state.data.
query('SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM patient');

Aggregate By District.description: Computes counts per district for a period, e.g. to send to DHIS2 as aggregate data values.
Aggregate By District.code:
// Aggregate a table by district for one month.
query(`
  SELECT district, COUNT(*) AS anc_visits
  FROM anc_visits
  WHERE visit_date >= '2026-10-01' AND visit_date < '2026-11-01'
  GROUP BY district
`);

Get Recent Records.description: Selects records added since a date so later steps can forward them.
